key_expressions: Did you finish organizing your materials?,
Should we adjust the time allocation?,
Shall we add one more example?,

A: Is your presentation preparation going okay?
Oh, that’s good to hear! Did you finish organizing your materials?
Nice. If you need help, I can give you a hand.
B: Yes, it’s going better than I expected!
I’m almost done, but I’m thinking about adding one more example.
Wow, thank you! Could you take a quick look for me?

A: How many minutes are you planning for the presentation?
Oh, that’s longer than I expected! It might be tricky to manage the time.
Right, maybe shortening the middle part could help.
B: I’m aiming for about ten minutes.
Yeah, once I start talking, it keeps getting longer.
That’s a good point. I’ll try shortening it.

A: How many slides did you prepare?
Oh, that sounds neat! Does the flow connect smoothly?
Great! You can keep it as it is—it's clear and natural.
B: Around twelve slides.
Yes, it flows well from the introduction to the conclusion.
Nice, then I’ll just polish it a bit more!

A: Did you prepare your opening line for the presentation?
Oh, that’s smooth and natural! It’ll sound good to the audience.
Great, keep that tone and continue naturally from there.
B: Yes, I’m planning to start with ‘Hello, I’ll be presenting today…’.
Do you think that sounds natural enough?
Nice! Thanks for the advice. I’ll practice it again.

A: Is there a part you’re most worried about?
Ah, that part? How about adding one more example?
Good idea! It might make it easier to understand.
B: Explaining the concept in the middle seems a bit difficult.
Oh, that’s actually a great suggestion!
I’ll add an example right away!

A: Have you practiced the presentation yet?
Oh! Then you must already have the flow in your head.
Nice. Want to try it once more right now?
B: I practiced twice on my own.
Yes, I didn’t get stuck too much when I tried.
Okay! I’ll try it now!

A: Did you prepare a closing line for the presentation too?
Oh, that’s clear and concise! It’ll wrap things up nicely.
Great. It also matches the overall tone well.
B: Yes, I’m planning to end with ‘This concludes my presentation.’
Should I add a thank-you line as well?
Oh, good idea! I’ll add that too.

A: Did you also prepare some possible answers for questions?
Oh, you predicted the questions well!
Nice! That should be enough preparation.
B: Yes, I wrote down a few expected questions.
I also prepared short answers for them.
Thanks! I feel more relieved now.

A: Do you think you can finish everything today?
Wow, then you’re almost done!
Great! You just need one last review.
B: Yes, at this pace I think I can.
I’ve organized almost all the slides.
I just need to check the last checklist!

A: Shall we do one final rehearsal then?
Oh, you look confident!
Great! With that energy, your presentation will go perfectly.
B: Sure! I’ll try it right now.
I feel like I can do well today.
Thanks for the encouragement! It really helps.
